---
title: "No dark mode when the only dark brand file is ignored"
format: html
brand:
  dark: comment-only-dark-brand.yml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'comment-only-dark-brand\.yml has no content and will be ignored'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['body.quarto-light']
        - ['body.quarto-dark', 'link.quarto-color-alternate']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['quarto-color-scheme-toggle']
---

The dark brand file is the only dark source and holds only comments, so it is ignored and the page has a single light mode.
